original.target_description: Published 2020 article, Study 1: 145 MTurk participants, 2 × 2 between-subjects design; left-digit difference ($4.01 vs. $3.00 versus $4.00 vs. $2.99) × stimulus-based simultaneous versus memory-based sequential presentation, predicting seven-point evaluation of the Great Value peanut-butter price relative to the premium-brand price. Target: left-digit difference × evaluation-mode ANOVA interaction.

notes: Fresh original-only extraction from the named published article, not a manuscript/proof or supplement. Title, authors and DOI match the supplied reference. Rendered PDF pages 4, 6 and 7 (published pp. 774, 776–777) were inspected to verify sample, design, interaction, effect-size column and p-value. The locator p.4&6 uses PDF pagination. The printed target outcome is the store-brand price-magnitude rating relative to the premium-brand price, operationalizing the described perceived price difference. Requested standardized beta is not printed for this ANOVA: retained printed partial eta-squared .033 for the same interaction as p = .029; no conversion. The frozen canonical text uses ¼ for the rendered equals sign, control glyph U+0004 for the rendered multiplication sign, and Z in the rendered eta-squared column header; quotations retain these exact glyphs and table spacing. Explicit ellipses mark omitted interleaved column text and intervening material; canonical line-end hyphenation is retained. Both assigned audit IDs identify this same original Study 1 interaction and were matched to that primary test. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders, not acquisition failures.
